improvement_suggestions.description: The resume should include keywords from the job description to improve its visibility to Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS). improvement_suggestions.title: Quantify accomplishments
improvement_suggestions.description: The resume should include specific, quantifiable results to demonstrate the impact of the candidate's work. Consider adding metrics or data points to support claims of success.

improvement_suggestions.description: The resume should be tailored to the specific requirements of the job description. Consider using keywords from the job description throughout the resume, and highlighting relevant skills and experience.
